summary: Short, very steep kerb beside homes at the McCaul Street bend.
reasons: Timed no-parking sign at its edge

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11 m and 15 m from the kerb on the same side; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a narrow residential street; cars park here but the grade is extreme.
drivers.convention: A few cars parked on the opposite kerb; timed no-parking sign applies 7-9 AM and Mon-Fri 2-5 PM.

flags: Timed no-parking sign 1 m from the kerb line
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees to the south-west give some afternoon shade.

best_section.where: McCaul Street south kerb, just before the bend
